purpose: Review the localized repair of GMResolutionDecision attachment, sentence-safe fidelity, and retry context after the 4 PASS / 4 FAIL live validation.
executive_summary: The live failures came from two implementation defects: prebuilt Resolution Contracts returned before a GMResolutionDecision was attached, and sentence-local validation rejected competent narration by treating any negation or entity mention as a full restatement of every authorized fact. Retry then asked for a repair without the contract or the decision. This repair attaches a decision to every existing contract without rebuilding it, scopes negation to the predicate it actually negates, allows multi-sentence realization and unknown cause/actor/time, keeps contract and decision on the retry note, and preserves already-valid sentences under the existing C18 seal. Deterministic tests cover the four live failures and the four live passes. Exact model/API call count: 0. Recommendation: proceed to a second limited live validation.

production: Existing Resolution Contracts now receive a GMResolutionDecision instead of returning before attachment. Matching decisions are kept. Contracts are not rebuilt.
Resolver replacement copies a decision whose contract_id matches the carried contract.
A discarded fast-path contract also drops its decision before a rebuild.
Narration prompts include the contract and the compact decision.
Negation is predicate-scoped. Entity mention is not a full fact claim. Neighboring sentences may realize one authorized answer. Unknown cause, actor, and time do not negate an established condition.
Polar questions record a direct authorized fact or a derived denial for the asked predicate.
Hard-invalid retry feedback includes the contract, the decision, and the validation failure.
After a failed retry, violating sentences can be dropped and the remainder revalidated and sealed. An established observation is used before the generic no-answer line.
